cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: I Pulled Away First
cards.instruction: Hide your role in creating the distance while working urgently to repair it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before your taxi comes, let's restart our letters. I've brought paper and stamps.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You never answered my last three.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. The post's been terrible. We can write the first ones here, bypass the whole system.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I handed you the last one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even better. Sit down; I'll write yours first. You can watch until there's enough to take home.

mechanism: A directs a supervised restart of letters while refusing to examine A unanswered letters, using procedural control to repair urgently without owning the distance.
confusable: D86 simply avoids the real reason; D85 must also actively and urgently repair a distance A helped cause.
comparison: Taxi-bounded letter writing differs from restoring door access before a special lunch cools.
seedUse: Use D85-a post excuse defeated by hand delivery, which prompts immediate witnessed writing rather than a new excuse.
